description: MACRO-style task DAG on maps/room_real.yaml (T built in the room). robot1 already holds the kit at A and carries it straight to the station at B (2), then switches it on (3); robot2 drives from B to A to fetch the tool (4); robot4 is idle in the stem. robot1 and robot2 drive towards each other along the bar until the swept-contact trigger; robot1's longer downstream chain makes MACRO's dag_aware ordering give it the priority branch, so robot4 and robot2 clear into the stem while robot1 waits, then passes.
